name: Wensity UI
summary: React and Next.js component library with animated components, section blocks, templates and a CLI, free and Pro tiers.
description: Copy-paste React and Next.js component library for Tailwind CSS: 235+ animated components and primitives plus 77 section blocks (heroes, social proof, pricing, FAQ, navbars, footers) across 12 categories, and full templates such as a fintech site, docs site and portfolio. Components install with the Wensity CLI or its shadcn registry and are copied into your repo. The free catalog needs no account; Pro Annual and Pro Lifetime unlock premium component and block source, and templates are bought one by one.
contains: templates: fintech, docs site, minimalistic portfolio (sold separately)
